604:t_5:12.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「$$クロノ$$ feared their existence and sought to prevent humanity as a whole from advancing into a new era... into the future.」

604:t_5:13.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「$$クロノ$$'s history... runs parallel to humanity's expansion into space.」

604:t_5:14.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「It began when humanity reached the Moon in each parallel world... and discovered something there.」

604:t_5:15.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「What they found was... a message to Earth's humanity from an unknown party.」

604:t_5:17.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「'Humanity is a species that must not be allowed to evolve.'」

604:t_5:18.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「From that moment, another intelligent species has controlled the history, the world, and the very existence of Earth's humanity.」

604:t_5:19.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「In other words, humanity has been kept as livestock.」

604:t_5:20.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「...Before the national leaders who had learned of the Moon's message, that being... whom I will call the overseer here... demonstrated its immense power.」

604:t_5:21.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「But it also guaranteed Earth's humanity would survive, provided we obeyed them.」

604:t_5:22.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「$$クロノ$$ is precisely the group of humans the overseers entrusted with monitoring evolution on their behalf.」

604:t_5:23.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「All history since then has been manipulated by $$クロノ$$... and thus by the overseers.」

604:t_5:24.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Following the overseers' orders, $$クロノ$$ has used many methods to control humanity.」

604:t_5:25.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Its primary policy was to regulate migration into space, the new environment that would allow humanity to evolve.」

604:t_5:26.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Migration itself was essential to humanity's survival, so they restricted settlers' freedom and sought to prevent humanity from adapting to its new environment.」

604:t_5:27.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「They eliminated anyone who opposed their wishes or advocated humanity's evolution.」

604:t_5:28.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「In the $$宇宙世紀$$ world, some members of $$クロノ$$ opposed this situation and tried to disclose the facts, leaving judgment to the people.」

604:t_5:29.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「That secret plan was to bear fruit as the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter, the foundation of a new era, but...」

604:t_5:30.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「As you already know, it was buried in darkness.」

604:t_5:31.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Thus, $$クロノ$$ continued its control over humanity in each parallel world.」

604:t_5:32.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「The assassination of $$ジオン・ズム・ダイクン$$ in the $$宇宙世紀$$ world, the assassination of $$ＡＤＷ$$'s leader $$ヒイロ・ユイ#keyword$$...」

604:t_5:33.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Even the $$宇宙世紀$$ world's $$一年戦争$$ was engineered as a pretext to oppress $$スペースノイド$$s.」

604:t_5:34.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「...But whatever methods $$クロノ$$ uses, humanity strives to move forward.」

604:t_5:35.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「I do not mean superficial human evolution, such as the appearance of $$ニュータイプ$$s or $$イノベイター$$s.」

604:t_5:36.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Humanity as a whole is about to enter a new era... by overthrowing the overseers who stand in its way: $$サイデリアル$$.」

604:t_5:37.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「...As someone who already belongs to the past, it is not my place to tell you how to act on these facts.」

604:t_5:38.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「But now that our era faces a new turning point, humanity must confront the fundamental calamity.」

604:t_5:39.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「You yourselves must choose whether to live in a limited present as tamed livestock, or in a future filled with infinite possibilities.」

604:t_5:40.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「All I can do is tell you the truth. It is you yourselves who will create the future from here.」

604:t_6:4.en:
$n
「$$偽りの黒羊$$, $$欲深な金牛$$, $$沈黙の巨蟹$$, $$傷だらけの獅子$$, $$悲しみの乙女$$, $$揺れる天秤$$, $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$立ち上がる射手$$, $$知りたがる山羊$$, $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, $$夢見る双魚$$...」

604:t_7:3.en: ～$$シャイアン基地$$ Underground　$$コロニーレーザー$$ Control Room～

604:t_7:4.en:
$$ローナン$$
「...How could this happen...? Not only $$ラプラスの箱$$, but $$クロノ$$'s existence and doctrine have been revealed to the whole world...」

604:t_7:5.en:
$$マーサ$$
「There's no need to be afraid.」

604:t_7:7.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Humanity has been under $$サイデリアル$$'s control for centuries...?」

604:t_7:8.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Then that's no different from now, with most of Earth conquered. It hardly changes anything at this point.」

604:t_7:9.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「...Bound by your family, your bloodline, and your power, you see nothing to question about this situation, do you?」

604:t_7:10.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Then what do you think humanity can do?」

604:t_7:12.en:
$$マーサ$$
「How admirable. Then let us place our hopes in $c.」

604:t_7:13.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「No, Aunt. All of humanity will fight.」

604:t_7:15.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I will take my leave now.」

604:t_7:16.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Where do you intend to go?」

604:t_7:17.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I will find my own way of fighting this world.」

604:t_7:19.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I understand. If I meet Ensign $$リディ$$, I will tell him you offered words of encouragement.」

604:t_7:24.en:
$$ローナン$$
「It's over... All of it.」

604:t_7:25.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Not yet. If we bring together the power of everyone under $$クロノ$$'s influence...」

604:t_7:27.en:
$$ローナン$$
「You are... the $$キング$$, aren't you?」

604:t_7:28.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「That title is meaningless now. $$サイデリアル$$ will abandon $$クロノ$$.」

604:t_7:30.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「The overseers' existence... Keeping that secret is $$クロノ$$'s doctrine... Having failed, we have outlived our usefulness.」

604:t_7:31.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Then what will we do?! If we lose $$サイデリアル$$'s backing...」

604:t_7:32.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「It is not for old men to decide what comes next.」

604:t_7:33.en:
$$ローナン$$
「It is their choice... As fathers, we have no choice but to accept it...」

604:t_7:35.en:
$$アクシオン$$
(My son... The world has been freed, just as you wished...)

604:t_7:37.en:
$$グエン$$
「Mr. $$アクシオン$$... Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ is apparently going to issue a statement to the entire world.」

604:t_7:38.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「The Empire is making its move... And so the world and the times begin to move...」

604:t_7:42.en: ～$$ラース・バビロン$$　Imperial Palace～

604:t_7:43.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...Foolish, feeble humans of Earth.」

604:t_7:44.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Everything that man calling himself $$エルガン・ローディック$$ said is true.」

604:t_7:45.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Know that since your ancestors' time, you have been the property of us, $$サイデリアル$$.」

604:t_7:46.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「You are merely a species allowed to live at our pleasure. I, Emperor $$アウストラリス$$, decide whether you live or die.」

604:t_7:47.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Does that humiliate you? Does it enrage you? Then come and unleash your anger on me.」

604:t_7:48.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I am here in $$ラース・バビロン$$. I have no intention of running or hiding.」

604:t_7:49.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I will be waiting. Challenge me, with this planet's future at stake.」

604:t_7:54.en:
$$シモン$$
「He's declaring war on the entire world...!」

604:t_7:55.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'd say that was aimed at us.」
